metadata.title: Micron Stock Is Falling Again but the Market Is Missing the Good News<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Is Falling Again but the Market Is Missing the Good News
Micron Technology shares were falling Wednesday after a sharp drop in the previous session. But its business looks healthy as it’s gaining market share.
